name: Clideo
tagline: Clideo is a suite of browser-based video tools including an editor, compressor, converter, merger, and subtitler. Its AI-powered auto subtitle feature transcribes video in 30+ languages and adds styled captions. No download required, making it the go-to for quick video tasks without installing software.
